item.title: HeungTology: Finding Industrial Knowledge with Traceable Sources
item.description:
The problem

Manufacturing knowledge is split across process, equipment, quality, defect, and corrective-action documents. As the collection grows, one machine acquires several names, relationships point to missing records, and unsupported explanations enter search results.

HeungTology is not a document-count project. It is a personal project for validating human-edited documents, tracing process and equipment relationships, and showing which source section supports a retrieved answer.

Area Public scope
Problem Duplicate identities, broken relationships, weak provenance, and local-path leakage
My scope Data structure, transformation and validation, graph representation, and retrieval design
Technologies YAML, JSON Schema, JSON-LD, OWL, SHACL, Neo4j, and Python
Current status Described only within the code and documentation visible in the public repository
Withheld claims Local release counts and completion ratings that cannot be reproduced from a public report

Why it is structured this way

Keeping authoring, graph exchange, and retrieval data in one hand-maintained file makes drift likely. The project therefore separates their responsibilities.

item.title: resumOpenAI: An Evidence-aware Resume Generation PoC
item.description:
Problem: controlling career facts matters more than fluent generation

resumOpenAI explores a narrower problem than “ask an LLM to write a resume.” It separates verified career facts, private fields, target-role selection, draft generation, and output validation so that polished wording cannot silently alter dates, employers, roles, or measured outcomes.

Area Design
Frontend React form and draft review
API Flask request validation and generation orchestration
Data structured career facts with evidence/status fields
LLM controlled prompt and optional adaptation path
Safety personal-data minimization and public/private separation
QA claim/date/number checks before export

Why structure comes before fine-tuning

Fine-tuning can make style more consistent, but it cannot repair missing or contradictory facts. The first quality gate is a structured source model.
